api_token_guide_title: How to get a Cloudflare API Token?
api_token_guide_step2: Click 'Create Token' and choose 'Create Custom Token'
api_token_guide_step3: Under Permissions, add: Account > Cloudflare Tunnel > Edit (and optionally Zone > DNS > Edit)
api_token_guide_step4: Under Account Resources, select 'Include > All accounts' (or your account) and finish.
